test.create_query: CREATE TABLE remerge_sort_small_blocks (c1 FixedString(34), c2 DateTime) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO remerge_sort_small_blocks SELECT toFixedString(concat('AB', substring(hex(sipHash128(number)), 1, 32)), 34), toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 'UTC') + intDiv(number * 7, 10) % 20000000 FROM numbers(30000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT c2, toString(c1) FROM (SELECT c2, c1 FROM remerge_sort_small_blocks ORDER BY c2 ASC, c1 ASC LIMIT 1000000) ORDER BY c2 DESC, c1 DESC LIMIT 1 FORMAT Null
